  name = "lockedFlag",
  // Read-only (never OPERATOR-writable): only the control logic sets it.
  type = "boolean",
  defaultValue = "false",
  flags = Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY
)
@NiagaraProperty(
  name = "blockNote",
  /* not OPERATOR: computed */ type = "double",
  flags = Flags.READONLY
)

  name = "knob",
  // a plain comment
  flags = Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.OPERATOR
)

public class BThing extends BComponent {}
